text: “Freedom is the freedom to say that two plus two make four.”
The line is about trusting plain evidence.
Even when the room disagrees.
Inner speech can bend the same way.
We tell ourselves what is easier to hear.
Notice when your inner voice says *it's probably fine*
and the facts say otherwise.
Honest self-talk is a form of freedom.
It costs a little comfort.
Say the plain thing to yourself first.
Then decide what to do about it.
A mind that can state the facts
can start to change them.
What plain fact have you been talking yourself out of?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Honest inner speech, step by step.
Say the plain thing *to yourself.*
Then act on it.

caption:
Look within. Within is the fountain of good.

Try five quiet minutes tonight and tell us what you find.

From "The 14-Day Clarity Reset." Type the word "Think" and I'll send you the link.

#thinkforyourself #marcusaurelius #stoicism #clarity #mindfulness

text: “Look within. Within is the fountain of good.”
Most of us look outward for the fix.
A new plan, a new tool, a new person.
Marcus kept pointing the other way.
The source of steadiness is nearer than that.
Looking within is not self-absorption.
It is checking the instrument before the work.
Five quiet minutes can do it.
No phone, no goal, just noticing.
Ask: what do I value? What is in my control?
Two questions are enough.
Dig a little each day.
The water was always there.
What would you find if you looked within for five minutes?
This is the thread behind the book *The 14-Day Clarity Reset*.
A practical reset, day by day.
Dig *within* first.
Then go out and act.

Send this to someone who values honesty.

#thinkforyourself #thoreau #truth #philosophy #criticalthinking

text: “Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.”
He listed the things most people chase.
Then he asked for something plainer.
Truth can disappoint.
That is why we are tempted to avoid it.
A thought-through life beats a flattering one.
Even when it is less comfortable.
Truth begins close to home.
With what you tell yourself about your day.
Ask: what is actually true here?
Not what I would like, not what they expect.
The answer gives you solid ground.
You can build from there.
What truth would you rather know than keep avoiding?
This is the thread behind the book *Learn To Think For Yourself*.
Thinking on solid ground.
Ask for *truth* first.
The rest can follow.

caption:
Knowledge itself is power.

Save this and trace one thought tonight.

From "The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech." Type the word "Think" and I'll send you the link.

#thinkforyourself #francisbacon #innerspeech #selfawareness #learning

text: “Knowledge itself is power.”
Bacon meant that understanding changes what you can do.
It is practical, not decorative.
The first thing worth knowing is yourself.
How you talk, how you react, what you assume.
Inner speech is the most available data you have.
It runs all day.
Take one thought and trace it back.
Where did it come from? Who taught it to you?
That small act of knowing is power.
You can edit what you can see.
Learn your own mind.
It is the tool for every other thing.
What do you most need to understand about your own mind?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Know your inner speech, then use it.
Knowing yourself is *power.*
Use it kindly.
